sole_target: one application-neutral and inference-neutral .clay pipeline executable + one SQLite MiniUnifiedDB
portable_release_shape: mini_entity.db SQLite MiniUnifiedDB preconfigurable as zero_blog
optional_inference_inputs: loopback OpenAI-compatible local server without token
local model weights plus configured local_exec runner

architecture_split.binary: generic evidence preprocessing, canonical run/state envelope, inference dispatch, immutable truth/secret gate engine, exactly-once consumption, generation CAS and atomic persistence
architecture_split.database: all application/personality/inference configuration; shipped default preset is zero_blog
architecture_split.regression_rule: if application/personality/inference choice can live in runtime configuration, binding it to executable identity is a regression

tested_behaviors: preset import can change identity/personality without rebuild
preset can choose API or local_exec inference
local model path can replace API token
local runner argv is configured as JSON and executed without shell
local inference output uses normal gate/exactly-once/CAS/atomic persistence path
same continuing DB supports materially different application/personality
API provider config remains runtime replaceable
loopback local API can run without token
missing authenticated API token consumes nothing

default_application.status: fully replaceable runtime configuration, not executable identity
default_application.default_inference: Mistral API profile, replaceable by any admitted API or local model backend

canonical_clay_state.profile_runtime: DB-resident active profile; external JSON is import/config only
canonical_clay_state.inference_contract: generic inference_generate dispatch rather than provider-specific call
canonical_clay_state.current_gap: native sandbox path proves local_exec backend contract; structured Clay runtime/effect implementation must converge on the same DB-resident profile + inference_generate contract, then real remote and real local model acceptance runs remain

current_frontier: Converge the structured Clay/effect runtime onto the proven native 0.6 backend contract, then exercise one real authorized remote provider and one real local supported LLM while preserving the application-neutral/inference-neutral binary boundary.
go_contract: Every go executes refresh -> swarm fan-out -> hypotheses/counterhypotheses -> implementation -> sandbox tests/falsification -> fusion/hypofusion -> fix -> retest -> persist on this same neutral pipeline + configurable DB only.
swarm_product_rule: one runtime entity only; swarm is research/build orchestration
